segments.text: An officer of the Third Riot Squad, which is in charge of keeping public order in the capital. She is assigned the duty of adjutant of Maruyama, Third Riot Squad's superintendent.
Unlike her commanding officer and other officers in her squad who are competitive with the protagonist and the Special Riot Police, Kimishima is one of the few officers that respects them.

In the crime scenes in the outskirts of the capital, she mostly appears together with the Superintendent Maruyama. It is routine procedure for her to report the arrival of the Special Riot Police to her superior.
Translated from the official site
首都の治安を担当する第三機動隊の隊員。
第三機動隊の丸山警視の副官的な役割を担当している。
特殊機動隊にライバル心を持っている隊長や他の隊員と違って、主人公たち特殊機動隊の隊員を尊敬している数少ない一人。
首都近郊の事件現場では、だいたい上司の隊長である丸山警視と一緒に登場する。
特殊機動隊が到着する際の報告を上司にする事が定番になっている
The commanding officer of the Third Riot Squad, which is in charge of keeping public order in the capital. He is a single man in his forties.

The Third Riot Squad, along with the Thirteenth Riot Squad, is regarded as an elite squad among the capital's public safety forces and gets high evaluations. He is responsible for the former. Maruyama frequently appears at crime scenes where the Special Riot Police have been dispatched, which are frequently entrusted with relatively minor Special Holders' crimes on the outskirts of the capital.

When faced with a heinous Special Holders' crime, his squad frequently effectively plays the role of stalling for time before the Special Riot Police arrival. Probably because of this, a significant number of officers in the squad regard the Special Riot Police as adversaries. One of them is the commanding officer. He is one of the ones forcibly tasked with cleaning up after the Special Riot Police, mainly it's second division.
Translated from the official site
首都の治安を担当する第三機動隊の隊長。
年齢は四十代半ば、独身。
首都の治安を担当する治安部隊では第十三機動隊と並び高い評価を受けている精鋭部隊の責任者。
首都近郊の異能力犯罪で比較的軽微な事件を担当することが多く特殊機動隊が派遣される事件現場では、だいたいこの人が登場する。
凶悪な異能力犯罪に対しては、結果的に特殊機動隊が到着するまでの時間稼ぎとしての役回りが多い為か隊員の中には主人公たちにライバル意識を持つ者も少なくなく、隊長もその一人である。
特殊機動隊、主に第二課の後始末を押し付けられる人の一人。

The head of the Home Ministry's Internal Security Assurance Bureau's Logistical Support Supervision Department. She is in charge of the logistical support units' supervision as the chief executive. She is a professional logistician who can handle everything from weapon maintenance to household chores. For some reason, the heads of all logistics units are clothed in maid uniforms. There's little doubt that this individual is at fault for the current situation...

Suzuka is a caring individual who exudes affection and maternal feelings. All of the Special Riot Police officers admire her and refer to her as "sister" or "mother." Still, when she's angry, she's terrifying. In the Security Assurance Bureau, she has more influence than Director Gotou.

She has a very glamorous figure. There is a mischievous side in her: having the most huge breast in the story, she forcibly hug the protagonist or the Special Riot Police girls and embarrass them. Prior to the formation of the Special Riot Police, Suzuka was a colleague of the protagonist. She had even been his old instructor. At that time, she was thought to be more powerful than the protagonist. For some reason, she is currently clearly distinct between then and now.
Translated from the official site
内務省 国内安全保障局 後方支援統括部 部長
後方支援部隊の統括であり最高責任者で、銃火器を始めとした武器の手入れから家事全般まで何でもこなせる後方支援のプロフェッショナル。
各補給部隊の責任者がなぜかメイド服なのかは、この人のせい、きっとたぶん……。
慈愛と母性にあふれた優しい性格で、特殊機動隊の全ての隊員たちから、お姉さん、お母さんとして慕われている。
ただし、怒るととても怖い。
国内安全保障局内の権力：古御門部長 > 梧桐局長
大変グラマラスな体型をしており、作中屈指の巨乳で主人公や特殊機動隊の女性陣にハグを強要して困らせるなどお茶目な一面も。
かつての特殊機動隊設立前の組織では主人公の同僚であり、元教官でもあった。
当時は主人公より剣術の腕は上とされていたが、とある事情により今は一線を引いている。

A big fox shikigami of the Special Riot Police's second division's officer Kuzunoha Kagura. He has been close with Kuzunoha Kagura and Kaguya since they were children, and they are like family to him. Unaki has a nervous nature. Kagura, the older sister, makes him worry, much as she does to her younger sister Kaguya. Frequently, when she makes an unreasonable request, he looks astonished and says: "Eh? Really?!".

Recently, if something happens in the second division, he tends to side with the protagonist rather than Kagura. It could be because there have been a lot of ridiculous requests lately. He now takes naps with the officers of the second division, Kotetsu and Isana, on a daily basis. In the naps, his role is to stand in for the pillow.

Unaki has the ability to understand people who cannot speak. Due to his smartness and dexterity, he is frequently assigned to missions such as converting acts, gathering intelligence, and rescuing hostages. He is also popular among children; they like to stroke him. He might be considered the second division mascot character.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第二課隊員の葛葉神楽に仕える大狐の式神。
葛葉神楽、神耶とは、彼女たちが幼い時から一緒におり、家族の一員のように仲が良い。
妹の神耶と同じく、姉の神楽に苦労させられる苦労狐としての一面があり、彼女の無茶ぶりに　え！マジで！と驚く表情をする事もしばしば。
最近は無茶ぶりをされる事が多かった為か、二課内で何かあると神楽より主人公の肩を持つことが多く、二課隊員である虎徹と伊紗奈とお昼寝（枕変わり）をすることが日課になっている。
言葉は話せないが人の言葉を理解しており、頭も良く動きも早い為、事件の際は隠密行動による情報収集や人質救出時の先方を任されることが多い。
子供にもふもふが大人気で、二課のマスコット的なキャラクター。

A veteran officer, assigned to the first division of the Special Riot Police. She is a person of honest and kind nature and is also very competent, thus she is the one who commands the first division as the chief's representative in an emergency.

She was a Home Ministry staff member. Being an excellent user of a Special Power by nature, she was scouted afterwards. That was her opportunity to enlist in the Special Riot Police. It was only after completing the Home Ministry Special Holders Assistance Research Office training course and graduating from a military academy that she was assigned to the first division. Kagura, her older sister, joined the Special Riot Police before her, so she often looks for her younger sister. Although Kaguya makes her worry all the time, they are wonderful sisters. Like her elder sister, Kagura, she sees Kotetsu and Isana as her little sisters. Kaguya respects both first and second division chiefs equally.

She, like her sister, has the power of youko as a Special Holder. She is capable of using shikigami, but her strong point rests elsewhere. It is fighting with a Japanese sword, imitating Shinobu, the chief of the first division.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第一課に配属されているベテラン隊員。
実直で優しい性格をしており、その実力はとても高く、有事の際、第一課司令の代理で部隊の指揮を任されるほど。
入隊の切っ掛けは、元々異能力の扱いに優れていたこともあって当時の内務省の職員からスカウトされた。
内務省 異能力者支援研究局の教育課程を修了後、士官学校に入学。
卒業後に特殊機動隊 第一課に配属された。
二課隊員の神楽の妹で、彼女より先に特殊機動隊へ入隊していたことから何かと彼女の面倒を見ることが多く、姉には気苦労ばかりかけられているが姉妹仲は良い。
姉の神楽と同様に、虎徹、伊紗奈を妹のように見ており、一課、二課の司令双方を同じくらい尊敬している。
異能保持者で、姉の神楽と同様に妖狐の異能を持つ。
式神を使役することも可能だが、第一課司令の志乃芙に倣い日本刀での戦いを得意としている。

An adjutant of Kusanagi Shinobu, the Special Riot Police first division chief. Originally a member of another government agency, she was chosen as a key personal candidate by the government due to her high real ability and Special Power.

Although Tsukishima is an excellent officer, she is young and not flexible enough. This causes some frictions with the second division. Kusanagi Shinobu, the second division chief, is someone she admires greatly. She may be called her beloved, faithful dog. While Tsukishima respects the second division chief, the protagonist, she is concerned about the possibility that the second division could cause an issue that will jeopardize the first division's (Shinobu's) recognition. In collaborative missions, she frequently quarrels with Kotetsu and Kagura.

Being a Special Holder, she has martial arts and firearms prowess on par with seasoned officers, but she is generally overseeing operational duties as an adjutant, therefore she rarely engages in combat.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第一課司令である草薙 志乃芙の副官を務めている。
元々は他の政府機関のスタッフだったが、その実務能力の高さと異能保持者であったことから、特殊機動隊の基幹要員候補として政府から抜擢された。
とても優秀な隊員だが、まだ若く柔軟性に欠けているところがある為、その事から二課との間に軋轢を作ってしまうこともしばしば。
第一課司令の草薙 志乃芙のことをとても尊敬しており、司令大好きっ娘の忠犬である。
第二課司令の主人公のことは、尊敬をしつつも、何かと問題を起こす二課が、ひいては一課（志乃芙）の評価を下げることにならないかとヤキモキしており、合同任務などで虎徹や神楽と言い争いをしてしまう事が多い。
異能保持者で、体術や銃器の取り扱いはベテラン隊員並みだが、主に副官として組織の運営業務を主としている為、戦闘に直接参加することは少ない。

An officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police, and a subordinate of Ayato. It hasn't been long since she was assigned to a second division, but she has now reached the point where she can no longer be considered a rookie. In the past, she had been targeted by criminal organizations because of her high potential for Special Power, but was saved by Ayato. After she was taken into custody, she completed a Home Ministry Special Holders Assistance Research Office training course and was sent to the second division. She is a kind, lively, and active girl who gives a cool impression during battles but is actually a considerate person. It is she who cheers up the second division.

Kotetsu expresses her emotions openly, respects the protagonist and is drawn to his strength. She also made a peer friend, rookie Tachibana Isana, and was able to enjoy the joys of youth like any other girl. She presents herself to her as a senior, but from the outside, it is often difficult to tell who is a senior.

As a Special Holder, she has a power of controlling a wind. It has a high versality: she apply it to a sword attacks, use vacuum caused by whirlwinds to cut enemies from the distance, rise her speed by a wind, soften an impacts, mitigate a damage and use it in other ways.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第二課に所属する隊員で、綜人の部下のひとり。
二課に配属されてまだ日が浅く、ようやく新人の肩書が取れそうなところまで来た隊員。
過去、身体に宿す異能力の潜在的な高さ故に、
非合法組織に狙われた経緯があり、綜人に助けられた過去を持つ。
保護された後、内務省異能力者支援研究局の教育課程を修了し、二課に配属された。
戦闘時はクールな印象を受けるが、実際は思いやりがあり、優しく元気で活発な女の子。
二課のムードメーカー。
感情表現が豊かで、主人公を尊敬し、主人公の強さに憧れている。
新人隊員の橘 伊紗奈という歳の近い友達との出会いもあり、人並みの女の子のように青春を謳歌出来るようになった。
彼女に対して先輩ぶりたい一面を持っているが、傍から見ていると、どっちが先輩かたまに分からなくなる時も。
異能保持者で、風を操る能力を持つ。
日本刀を用い風を剣撃に載せ、かまいたちによる遠距離の攻撃も可能、風を操ることで、自身の移動速度の向上、衝撃を緩和してダメージ軽減したりと汎用性が高い。

A rookie officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police not long ago. Among the officers, she is an unusual case: she attends an academy while also serving as a Special Riot Police officer at the same time. Isana doesn't say much and appears to be cold. As a result, she gives off the impression of being difficult to approach, but in reality, she is a kind and cheerful young lady who simply struggles to express her feelings. She had awakened her Special Power in early childhood. In the past, she had been in a lot of troubles due to her latent power, but Ayato saved her.

The fact that she was enamored by her savior, Ayato, played a big factor in her enlistment in the Special Riot Police. Among the officers, she is especially close with Kotetsu and spends a lot of time with her. When cases unfold before her eyes, Isana grows as an officer and a woman thanks to the influence of emotional Kotetsu, lessons from adult seniors, and confrontations with people and Special Holders.

As a Special Holder, she has the power of swiftness. Her forte is cutting enemies with her Japanese sword, making use of her godlike speed. In truth, she uses the same style as Ayato because she is enchanted by him. Even among the officers, her instantaneous force is exceptional. As a result, in missions where a quick solution is required, such as hostage delivery, she is extremely valuable in attacking swiftly and rendering an opponent powerless.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第二課に配属されて日も浅い新人隊員。
隊員の中では珍しく、学園に通いながら、特殊機動隊の隊員を兼任している。
口数が少なく、凛とした姿から近寄りがたい雰囲気を持っているが、実際は少し感情表現が不器用なだけで優しくて明るい女の子。
幼い頃、異能力に目覚めた際、その潜在的な力が原因で事件に巻き込まれ、綜人に助けられた過去を持つ。
特殊機動隊へ入隊した経緯については、過去に助けてくれた綜人への憧れから来ているところが大きい。
隊員の中では特に虎徹と仲が良く、一緒に過ごすことが多い。
感情豊かな虎徹の影響や、大人な先輩たちからの学び、人間と異能保持者との確執による事件を目の当たりにしていくことで、隊員として、一人の女性として成長していく。
異能保持者で、俊足の能力を持ち、神速を活かした日本刀による斬撃を得意とする。
（実際は綜人に憧れている為、同じスタイルにしている。）
瞬発力は隊員の中でもトップクラスの為、人質供出など迅速な解決が望まれる任務では、
いち早く切り込んで相手を無力化する際に大いに役だっている。

A veteran officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. She is always gentle and kind to everyone, acting as if she were an elder sister or mother in front of the officers and listening to their concerns. As a result, the second division's junior officers regard her as a big sister or mother. She cherishes Kotetsu and Isana as if they were her little sisters. Her hobby is serving black tea, delectable meals, and those kinds of things to everyone.

Since the old days, Kanade has witnessed the perseverance of the second division chief, Ayato, at his side. At work, she always devotedly support him. At the same time, she wants to alleviate his fatigue and pamper him. All officers, who manage logistical work, are clothed in maid uniforms. Actually, there is a reason for this.

As a Special Holder, she has some sort of comprehension power. It consists of cybernetic psychometry, specializing in electronic information. Kanade uses an information terminal. When she joins a computer network, she can quickly analyze information. When it comes to electrical locking devices, she can find a way to manipulate them simply by touching them.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第二課に配属されているベテラン隊員。
主に二課の後方支援を担当しており、事件起きた際のブリーフィングオペレーター、二課司令の秘書的な役割も兼任している。
常に物腰柔らかく、誰に対しても優しく接する性格で、隊員に対して姉や母のように振る舞い、悩みを聞いてあげたりと、二課の若い隊員達からお姉さん、お母さんとして慕われている。
虎徹、伊紗奈を妹のように可愛がっており、みんなに、紅茶や、美味しいご飯をふるまうことを趣味としている。
二課の司令である綜人の頑張りを昔から傍で見ており、仕事において献身的なサポートをすると共にいつも癒してあげたい、甘やかしたいと想っている。
後方支援の業務に携わる隊員は、なぜか皆メイド服を着ているがこれは立派な制服であり、実は理由がある。
異能力保持者で、サトリの能力の一種である、電子情報系に特化したサイバネティックサイコメトリーの能力を持つ。
情報端末の操作、サイバーネットワークにアクセスする際、高速で情報解析が可能であり、電子制御機械が相手なら、触れることである程度の制御方法を知ることができる。

A veteran officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. Shikigami Unaki, with whom she has grown up since early childhood, is like a family to her. Nonetheless, from the outside, that treatment may appear harsh.

She is an extravagant person who fiercely conceals her feelings and thoughts about her comrades. She believes Kanade, Kotetsu, and Isana to be particularly troublesome juniors, but she nevertheless looks after them properly. Kagura is a little high-handed towards Ayato, the second division chief, but this is due to her desire to show him, whom she loves and respects, her good sides. She frequently gets worked up about her inability to be honest. Kaguya, her little sister, is a serious but somewhat awkward young lady. She is prone to worry, but although Kagura is making her do so all the time, they are wonderful sisters.

As a Special Holder, she has the power of youko. She uses fox shikigami and spiritist amulet practices. Kagura with shikigami Unaki, who has the ability to comprehend the speech of people with ego, greatly assists the second division in combat by performing a variety of tasks such as scouting and surprise attacks.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第二課に配属されているベテラン隊員。
式神使いで、常日頃から狐の式神を使役している。
特に小さな頃から一緒に育った式神のウヌキは、家族と同様に扱っている。
（といっても周りから見て、結構扱いは荒い。）
前向きで奔放的な性格だが、仲間を想う気持ちを強く秘めており、特に同僚の奏と共に、虎徹，伊紗奈を手の掛かる後輩と見ながらも良く面倒を見ている。
二課の司令である綜人に、ちょっと高飛車な態度を取ることもあるが、これは敬愛する彼に良いところを見せたいと思う気持ちの裏返しであり、素直になれない自分にヤキモキすることもしばしば。
真面目だが、少し不器用なところのある妹の神耶カグヤがいる。
苦労性な妹に気苦労ばかりかけているが、姉妹中はとても良い。
異能力保持者で、妖狐の異能を持つ。
狐の式神を使役し、護符を用いた霊術を使用する。
自我を持ち人間の言葉を理解できる式神の大狐ウヌキと共に偵察や奇襲といった幅広い任務を担当することで、二課を戦闘面で大きく支えている。

The chief of the Special Riot Police first division. The first division consists of top-picked officials from the government body. This force is critical to the government's plan to enhance the organization by arranging for officers who gained experience in the first division to be transferred to crucial positions in other ones. She was appointed to the position of the first chief of the first division due to her abilities and popularity. Shinobu is popular among both men and women since she is strong-willed while still being kind and caring. She may be described as a handsome woman.

There are occasionally disagreements between the first division, which is made up of elite officers, and the second division, which frequently appoints officers from private citizens, but the head of the first division is respected by all officers regardless of affiliation. Her sworn friend and supporter is second division chief Ayato, who was her colleague prior to the formation of the Special Riot Police.

Shinobu is not a Special Holder, but she is descended from a long line of demon eradicators who were responsible for the country's protection. She is an all-rounder with a high skill in swordsmanship, firearm use, and hand-to-hand fighting thanks to her spiritual force, her lineage's techniques, and her physical aptitude. She is so strong that, in the times of suppressing the coup d'état in the Self-Defense Forces, she cut a tank in half with her sword. Her strength is comparable to that of Ayato, the second division chief.
Translated from the official site
特殊機動隊 第一課の司令。
一課は政府機関の中でも選りすぐりの隊員により構成されたエリート部隊であり、一課で経験を積んだ隊員を基幹要員として新設した課に移籍配置させ組織を増強していく政府計画の要でもある部隊である。
彼女はその能力と人望により、第一課の初代司令として任命された。
男勝りな一面もあるが、優しく面倒見も良く、男女問わずモテる、所謂イケメン女子。
エリート隊員で構成される一課と、民間からの登用が多い二課とは、隊員同士で何かと軋轢があるが一課司令である彼女は、所属を問わず隊員から尊敬されている。
二課司令の綜人とは、特殊機動隊設立前からの同僚であり、悪友であり、良き理解者でもある。
異能保持者ではないが、護国を司る古の退魔師の家系で霊力と退魔術による身体能力による剣技、銃器、格闘などを高い水準でこなすオールラウンダー。
過去に自衛軍が起こしたクーデターを鎮圧した際は戦車を刀で切断するなど、一課司令の綜人と比肩しうる実力を持っている。

The protagonist of this story. He is the chief of the Special Riot Police second division, who is capable of performing any task: from nursing a kid to repelling tanks. While being a chief, he is a militarist who leads his subordinates himself to solve cases, wielding his Japanese swords on the fields. He is an ordinary human, not a Special Holder. Despite this, he is insanely strong and feared on the underside of society.
His ideal world is one in which humans and Special Holders may coexist without discrimination. Those who understand his operations trust him because of his real activities and competence.

Ayato fought without thinking about the danger to himself in the past, when he was a member of an organization that was ancestral to the Special Riot Police, but he grew and was selected for the position of Special Riot Police second division chief thanks to the support of his comrades and the experience he gained. Close combat with Japanese swords is his forte. In times of suppression of the Japanese Self-Defense Forces coup d'état, he repelled multiple tanks with his swords. It has since become a legend.
Translated from the official site
子守から戦車の撃退まで出来る、特殊機動隊 第二課の司令で本作の主人公。
司令という立場ながら、現場で日本刀を振るい、隊員達の先頭に立って事件を解決する武闘派。
異能保持者ではなく普通の人間だが、理不尽と思えるほど強く、裏社会では大変恐れられている。
人、異能保持者が分け隔てなく暮らせる世界を理想としており、実際の行動と実力が伴っている為、彼の行動を理解している周囲からの信頼は厚い。

A former officer of the Ground Self-Defense Forces' first division. In the past, he was a promising young officer in the Ground Self-Defense Forces, but his wife and daughter were murdered by a heinous Special Holder criminal, and he was heavily wounded but survived.

In the despair of losing his family, he despised Special Holders, yet he had awakened a Special Power himself. It has resulted in him losing his position at the organization that treats Special Holders negatively. Having his family killed, having became a detested Special Holder himself, having retired from the forces due to it, Yuuichirou has closed his heart in fury and hatred with no outlet.
After he had retired from the troops, his whereabouts were considered unknown, but in fact he was undertaking illegal operations under the command of Lieutenant General Saejima.
Translated from the original site

The commander of the first division of Ground Self-Defence Forces, affiliated with the General Defense Ministry. He is a man in his mid-fifties and a subordinate of Minister Sugawara. His abilities are highly regarded as a result of his efforts to rebuild the Self-Defense Forces following previous turbulence caused by a coup d'état raised by one of the organization's academies.

Saejima feels, that Special Powers are dangerous, and discriminate against them. He is a member of Radical Faction, which opposes Director Gotou's Moderate Faction. He is unfriendly to Special Riot Police officers, who are mild in their treatment of Special Holders' criminals. A ruthless man who will go to any length to achieve his objectives. Many of his subordinates, who share his ideals, have a deep respect for him.

The rate of organized crime among Special Holders has been rising, and it was hard to combat it with only Home Ministry forces. As a result, the Self-Defense Forces have the authority to preserve the country's public order. Being the one in charge of Ground Self-Defense Forces, defending the outskirts of the capital, he is calling for an expansion of military armaments.
Translated from the official site

The General Defense Minister. He oversees the General Defense Ministry's functions, including national defense, internal disaster relief, and command of the Self-Defense Forces. He is about fifty years old. His abilities are highly regarded as a result of his efforts to rebuild the Self-Defense Forces following previous turbulence caused by a coup d'état raised by one of the organization's academies.

Sugawara has known the protagonist's superior, Director Gotou, for a long time. At the same time, he is his friend. He is a person who gets along well with the Special Riot Police officers, who have a lot of disagreements with the Self-Defense Forces over how to deal with organized crime among Special Holders. Repeatedly intervene in subordinates, who sees the protagonist and his division as rivals, and admonishes them.

The rate of organized crime among Special Holders has been rising, and it was hard to combat it with only Home Ministry forces. As a result, Ground Self-Defense Forces got more influence. Sugawara is concerned about dealing with its first division commander, Lieutenant General Saejima. While he has high hopes for the protagonist's and his division's activities, his heart, like Gotou's, can not stop skipping beats.
Translated from the official site

The director of the Home Ministry's Internal Security Assurance Bureau. He is the protagonist's superior and is in charge of the Special Riot Police. Gotou is about fifty years old. He is a highly talented government official, who is also a laid-back individual in ordinary life. He is the leader of the Moderate Faction, to which the government's top officials currently belong, and one of the few high officials who is actually working to bring humans and Special Holders to a harmonious coexistence.

Once, in the turbulent times, being a head of a department, he has founded a Anti Special Holders Organized Crime Department's Special Riot Police together with current Home Minister, who was a Vice Minister at that time.

Nowadays, the rate of organized crime among Special Holders rises after a particular case. He has high expectations for the protagonist and the operations of his division, but his heart can not stop skipping beats because he is the one who has to deal with the consequences of their acts.
Translated from the official site
The commanding officer of the Thirteenth Riot Squad, which is in charge of keeping public order in the capital. He is in his mid-forties.
The Thirteenth Riot Squad, along with the Third Riot Squad, is regarded as an elite squad among the capital's public safety forces and gets high evaluations. He is responsible for the former.

Oodomo is unfriendly to Special Riot Police officers, who are mild in their treatment of Special Holders' criminals. He is a riot squad commanding officer who is also devoted to the ideas of Lieutenant General of Ground Self-Defense Forces, Saejima. He is one of the ones forcibly tasked with cleaning up after the Special Riot Police, mainly it's second division.
Translated from the official site

An officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. Ayato's subordinate. She is a member of the Support Squad, along with her colleague Shiraishi, whose primary mission is to provide cover for the Ayato and heroines.

It hasn't been long since Saotome joined the Special Riot Police, and she still lacks experience compared to other officers, but she works hard since she is an earnest and upright person. Therefore, her colleagues regard her as someone who will become a veteran before long.

Together with Shiraishi, she is tasked with defending the peace and safety of ordinary citizens and struggling to fulfill the order every day. Shiraishi regards her as a junior and teases her frequently, yet he also helps her greatly.
Translated from the official site
An officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. Ayato's subordinate. He is a member of the Support Squad, whose primary mission is to provide cover for the Ayato and heroines.

Shiraishi is a reliable young man, in whom his colleagues have a great deal of trust. His practical ability as a Special Riot Police officer is so high that he can be considered a veteran. Furthermore, his accomplishments cannot be overlooked. For these reasons, his superiority in the organization is acknowledged. He is tasked with defending the peace and safety of ordinary citizens and struggling to fulfill the order every day.

He has many friends, ranging from children to the elderly. Many female staff members are also attracted to him. Still, he does not have a lover. That fact may be due to his natural blockheadness. Shiraishi is frequently paired with his colleague, Saotome. As a good senior, he helps her in a variety of ways.
Translated from the official site
She used to be a regular girl going to school in the city, but one day she manifested a Special Power that turned her invisible. As a result, she was forced to live as a person, invisible to anyone.
The girl has witnessed the perpetrator of the underground electricity cable bombing case. Due to it, she came to cooperate with the protagonist and his division.
Translated from the official site

A former non-commissioned officer of the Ground Self-Defense Forces and a Special Holder with a peculiar ability to manipulate space. This ability makes him able to store innumerable weapons and ammunition in his clothes or at home, despite the weight remaining the same.

During previous disturbances, as a non-commissioned officer of the Self-Defense Forces, Big Sergeant put up a lot of effort to quell the chaos. It is because of his activities at that time that he was remembered as "Big Sergeant."

After the unrest was quelled, he was discharged from the troops. Afterwards, he led a quiet life with his family. Big Sergeant showed up again after an unknown group captured the Special Holders Support Research Facility, an important government institution: being the commander of that terrorist group, he engaged in battle with the Special Riot Police.
Translated from the official site

A manager of the far east branch of the big international military-industrial corporation, Pixie Industries. He appears to be a straightforward businessman, but that is not the whole of him: in truth, he is an arms dealer, scheming to destabilize the world political situation and seeking to gain control of the economy through the corporation.

Ryuu believes that in order to maintain peace now that Special Holders are running rampant, it is vital to rely on a deterrent force, namely weapons. He arrived in Japan in order to get in touch with radical factions in the Japanese government.
Translated from the official site
